title: Console Insights v2: Launch orchestration, release notes coordination, and enablement pack for dashboards + rollouts + cost breakdowns
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Orchestrate the GA launch for Console Insights v2 which includes: (1) route-level dashboards for latency/cost/usage, (2) adaptive rollout controls with canary/A-B and automatic fallback, and (3) per-token and per-route cost breakdowns. This ticket coordinates release notes, cross-team launch tasks, training materials, and enablement for CS/SEs/GTMs. Goal: ensure a smooth customer-facing launch with clear docs, runbooks, and measurable adoption KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes draft completed and approved by legal and docs
Console in-app tour and contextual help for the three features is live in staging
Training sessions scheduled and recorded; enablement kit posted to Drive
Support runbook created with escalation matrix and common troubleshooting flows
Launch checklist items completed and sign-offs from Eng, Design, Security, and Sales Ops
success_metrics: Adoption: 30% of active orgs use route dashboards within 30 days of GA
Rollout usage: 20% of eligible routes adopt adaptive rollouts within 45 days
Cost transparency: 50% reduction in basic cost-related support tickets within 60 days
Customer satisfaction: NPS change +3 in customers using Insights v2 features
required_assets: Drive: Enablement kit (deck, one-pager, FAQ, recorded training)
GitHub: PRs for console-ui (#6372, #6391) and backend metrics service (#4210)
communication_plan: Week -2: Internal announcement to Eng, Design, Docs, SEs with embargoed feature brief
Week -1: Sales + CS enablement session (live) + recording posted
Day 0 (GA): Public release notes + blog post + in-app announcement + targeted emails to beta participants
Day 0..14: Office hours (twice) with PM/Eng for early adopter questions
Week 2..6: Follow-up case studies & segment-targeted comms for high-usage customers
release_notes_drafts: Short blurb for product homepage highlighting dashboards, rollouts, cost breakdowns
Technical notes for API changes and migration guidance (no breaking changes expected)
Upgrade notes for Dedicated/Private customers: compatibility and config flags
Known limitations and recommended workarounds (KV cache visibility, long-tail latency measurements)
training_sessions: Sales engineering deep-dive: configuration and customer use-cases - 90m
CS troubleshooting workshop with runbook scenarios - 60m
Office hours: weekly for first 2 weeks after GA - 45m each
launch_checklist: Docs: public help center article + API reference updated
UI: in-app tour and 'What's new' modal enabled
Telemetry: metrics and dashboards instrumented (latency, cost per-token, adoption)
Billing: cost breakdown surfaced, validated on staging accounts
Rollouts: default rollout policy set and tested on canary orgs
Observability: SLOs and alerts configured for new endpoints
Legal: release notes and marketing copy sign-off
Support: runbook, escalation contacts, and sample logs available
Marketing: launch blog and social assets ready
SE Enablement: demo script and sandbox org prepared
post_launch_tasks: Top customer feedback triage and prioritization (first 30 days)
Adoption deep-dive: identify low-adoption segments and prepare outreach
Track and report success metrics to leadership at 30/60/90 days
Plan quick wins backlog for v2.1 based on support tickets and early feedback
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cost breakdown shows unexpected variability for small customers -> Mitigation: add rollup mode and explanatory docs in initial release
Risk: Rollout controls are misconfigured causing accidental traffic shifts -> Mitigation: defaults to conservative canary + require owner confirmation for region-wide rollout
Risk: Documentation lags behind UI changes -> Mitigation: freeze UI changes 3 business days before GA and prioritize docs PRs
Risk: High support volume on day 1 -> Mitigation: staff rotations for support + SE on-call coverage + prepared canned responses
timeline: Feb 15: scope confirmed and kickoff. Feb 20 - Mar 1: final engineering stabilization and design polish. Mar 2 - Mar 9: docs + release notes + enablement content creation. Mar 10 - Mar 12: staging sign-off, rehearsals, training sessions. Mar 13: GA launch to public. Mar 13 - Apr 13: post-launch monitoring and adoption efforts.
notes: This ticket consolidates coordination work previously split across smaller PM tasks. Keep tight coordination with ENG-4721 (metrics backend) and DES-1142 (dashboard components). If any blocker appears on security review, escalate to Head of Security within 24 hours.
